name: io.github.stvoorhees/readonly-db-mcp
description: Read-only database and SSAS tabular-model access via structured tools; the server authors all SQL and DAX.

packageArguments.name: --connections
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated names of configured connections this server instance exposes to the agent. Required; names must exist in the local config file.

environmentVariables.name: READONLYDB_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the connections config file. Defaults to %USERPROFILE%/.readonlydb/config.json.
